name: customer-feedback-sentiment
title: Customer Feedback Sentiment
description: An aggregate user rating overview with NPS score breakdown, star reviews, and verified feedback quotes.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Customer Feedback Sentiment Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
